question: Ilang beses kailangang i-publish sa diyaryo ang notice of pending application para sa reclassification ng zoning?
answer: Sa iyong kahilingan, ang notice of pending application sa reclassification ng zoning ay dapat i-publish sa diyaryo tatlong beses, bawi sa dalawang linggo (3 weeks). Ito ay nakasaad sa [S1] sa chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0037-C001 sa page 666 ng Citizen Charter ng City Planning.

ground_truth: For re-zoning and reclassification, applicants must post a visible project sign issued by the Zoning Administrator at the site and publish a Notice of Pending Application in a local newspaper once a week for 3 consecutive weeks before public hearing deliberations.
